text:
3 former Life High School Waxahachie athletes appear on college rosters for week ending Sept. 6
By
J. B. BordenThree former Life High School Waxahachie athletes are listed on college rosters for the week ending Sept. 6. Sophomore Kaylynn Griffis is with Converse women's soccer, which visits Lander University on Sept. 2.
The athletes represent women's soccer and women's volleyball at Alverno, Converse and Eastern. The teams have eight scheduled events during the week ending Sept. 6.
Each athlete's college team and scheduled events are listed below.
Former Life High School Waxahachie Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Kaylynn Griffis
Converse women's soccer — Conference Carolinas
Schedule: Visits Lander University on September 2 in Greenwood, SC; Visits King University (Tenn.) on September 5 in Bristol, TN
Grace Gomez
Eastern women's soccer
Schedule: Visits CSU Pueblo on September 3 in Pueblo, CO; Visits Adams State on September 5 in Alamosa, CO
Olivia McCann
Alverno women's volleyball — Northern Athletics
Schedule: Visits University of Mary Hardin-Baylor on September 3 in Belton, TX; Hosts Millsaps College on September 4 in Belton, TX; Hosts Texas Lutheran University on September 4 in Belton, TX; Hosts LeTourneau University on September 5 in Belton, TX
